records.section: Runbook — Story/RPG mode tech spike (post-launch, P2)
records.requirementOrFinding: Story mode is a **rework of the legacy trainers' story/adventure/quest modes** (v1 dropped them in its migration), not greenfield. Scope + tech are decided WITH Koki after a spike — this file carries what the spike starts from. The architecture already reserves the integration point: `packages/engine` is pure TS and a story route can mount a canvas/WebGL client via `next/dynamic({ ssr: false })`, consuming the same content engine + grading as everything else.
